title: Temporal task-property screen: two new axes + reservoir-programmatic hybrid + reservoir growth
question: Which task property predicts whether recurrence pays, and does a reservoir+programmatic hybrid beat both parents? Does residual-targeted reservoir growth help?

mackey_glass_anchor.note: the sealed M147 axis, reproduced exactly (anchor); the M147 parameters unchanged

lorenz.note: Lorenz-63 x-component, RK4, sampled every 0.1 time units — the second chaotic axis.

dyck_grammar.note: seeded Dyck-like next-token task over two bracket pairs (balanced-depth random walk); the discrete-structure axis where the M134 prior predicts a reservoir loss.

arms.no_memory: ridge on the current step alone
arms.reservoir: the M147 fixed random reservoir, the M147 ladder unchanged (seeds {21,22,23} x units {64,256,1024} x rho {0.5,0.9,0.99}, warmup 200, ridge penalty 1.0)
arms.hybrid: reservoir state CONCATENATED with the primitive features + ridge (must beat BOTH parents)
arms.growth: reservoir + residual-targeted append of 128 units (fitted on the static reservoir's error steps, echo-state property re-verified after append); control = random-append 128 units

anchors.m134_dsl: the M147 t1 anchor path (reservoir r128 DSL reproduction, delta 0.000000 sealed)

gate.registered: per new axis: reservoir best >= 5% relative over the best non-recurrent arm (the M147 rule); the hybrid must beat BOTH parents; growth must beat static reservoir AND the random-append control. Echo-state property checked (spectral radius < 1, warm-up discarded) before any readout.
